_about: Ground-truth manifest for the meeting-briefings QA test packet. Each case maps a seeded condition in an artifact to the QA module it exercises, the bucket it belongs to, the rubric dimension it covers, and what the QA spine should conclude. A check author can target any case directly. See README.md for how to run and read this.
_layers_about: packet_version 3.0 refactored the defect suite into two layers; 3.1 dropped the orphaned packet-1.0 layer (universal_artifact + variant_operational_*) that no meta-test exercised. LAYER 1 (unit) is a SINGLE unit packet, unit_check_packet.json, that folds the per-claim/per-item defects into one file; each case is asserted PER-CHECK on its target (check_id + offending), IGNORING the packet's overall release_verdict. This is the primary ask: verify each individual check catches what it should. LAYER 2 (integration) is a small set of thin whole-artifact fixtures where release_verdict matters (one block-routed defect, one annotate-routed defect, a whole-doc identity case, a whole-doc schema case), plus the clean baseline as the ok control. Each case below carries a 'layer' field (unit | integration | roadmap_gap). The unit meta-test is scripts/python/test_qa_spine_unit_checks.py; the integration meta-test is scripts/python/test_qa_spine_integration_verdict.py.
_rubric_about: Rubric-driven coverage sits on top of the agent-assembled clean baseline. The Meeting Briefing QA Rubric has 5 scored dimensions (Accuracy, Grounding & Traceability, Prioritization, Coverage, Actionability) and 4 gating checks (no political advocacy, no toxic/discriminatory, no inappropriate PII, professional register). Each defect case carries a rubric_dimension; the top-level rubric_coverage object summarizes which dimensions are covered by a deterministic check today vs. a roadmap gap.
provenance: Structure and source prose adapted from the example briefings in .reference_docs/mb_runs/ (notably develop_baseline_artifact.json). Jurisdiction, official, and all seeded defects are fictional and synthetic — no real council or person is the subject of a planted defect. No real voter, personnel, or financial records are used.
calibration: All deterministic expectations below were calibrated by running `uv run python qa_validate.py <artifact> --no-llm --no-check-urls` (equivalently qa_validate.run_deterministic) on develop. The agent_assembled_baseline cases, the unit_check_packet cases, and the thin integration variants were calibrated 2026-06-08 during the unit-vs-integration refactor. expected_llm entries are human-asserted and require the Phase 1/2 LLM layer to confirm (run without --no-llm). The automated meta-tests are scripts/python/test_qa_spine_unit_checks.py (layer 1) and scripts/python/test_qa_spine_integration_verdict.py (layer 2).

buckets.passes_today: The condition is correct/healthy and the spine treats it as acceptable.
buckets.fails_caught: The condition is a defect and today's spine surfaces it (block, annotate, or diagnostic).
buckets.fails_not_yet_caught: The condition is a defect but no current check surfaces it — the roadmap. proposed_check names the check that should exist.

agent_assembled_baseline.json.note: Realistic clean baseline assembled by a clean-context sub-agent following the offline meeting_briefing instruction over a synthetic hybrid agenda packet (15 items, 16 claims, 13 sources spanning agenda_packet / news / haystaq). The integration ok-control AND the base every other packet-3.0 fixture derives from. Verdict ok. Two diagnostic warnings are benign and do NOT drive the verdict: (1) source_hierarchy_policy reports a policy gap for the claim_types with no hierarchy entry [constituent_sentiment, news_context, staff_recommendation]; (2) summary_source_coherence flags item_005 and item_010 as faithful-paraphrase false positives.

unit_check_packet.json.note: LAYER 1 unit packet. The clean baseline with several targeted per-claim/per-item defects folded into ONE file, each isolated so only its intended check reacts on its target. The overall release_verdict (block) is IRRELEVANT to the unit assertions and is recorded only for completeness — the unit meta-test asserts each check individually by check_id + offending, never the verdict. Caught targets: extracts_appear_in_cited_source (claim_008), high_stakes_structured_match (claim_004), source_hierarchy_policy (claim_005), prohibited_phrases (item_001). Should-not-fire targets: truncated extract (claim_009), advocacy inside quoted source (NEWS-2/claim_010), faithful-paraphrase coherence (item_005/item_010, inherited from baseline).

variants/variant_single_blocking_defect..note: LAYER 2. Exactly one block-routed defect: claim_008's extract is absent from its cited source, so extracts_appear_in_cited_source blocks. The only hard-block family observed in the 488-briefing replay.

variants/variant_single_annotate_defect..note: LAYER 2. Exactly one annotate-routed defect: advocacy 'Push for' in an authored display.summary makes prohibited_phrases annotate (never block) -> warn.

variants/variant_identity_missing.json.note: LAYER 2. Whole-doc identity check: official_name blanked, so identity_fields_present blocks (route=block). schema_validation also flags the minLength violation as an annotate, but identity_fields_present drives the block.

variants/variant_schema_drift.json.note: LAYER 2. Whole-doc schema check: an extra top-level property (draft_notes) violates additionalProperties:false. schema_validation is staged as annotate during the trial window, so it warns rather than blocks -> warn.

expected_deterministic.note: policy-gap diagnostic — does not drive verdict
faithful-paraphrase false positives on item_005 and item_010 — diagnostic, does not drive verdict

cases.rationale: The agent-assembled clean baseline runs end-to-end with verdict ok. Two diagnostic warnings (source_hierarchy_policy gap; summary_source_coherence on item_005/item_010) are expected and benign — route=diagnostic never drives the verdict. The integration ok-control and the base every other packet-3.0 fixture derives from.

Exactly one block-routed defect: claim_008's source_extract is absent from its cited src_streetscape snapshot, so extracts_appear_in_cited_source (route=block) fails and the verdict resolves to block. The only hard-block family observed in the 488-briefing replay.

Exactly one annotate-routed defect: the advocacy phrase 'Push for' in item_001's authored display.summary makes prohibited_phrases (route=annotate) warn, so the verdict resolves to warn (never block).

Layer-1 schema_validation also flags the minLength violation as an annotate, but identity_fields_present drives the block. expected_deterministic.offending: claim_008: 'The selection committee unanimously praised the bidder's saf…' (best_fuzzy=44)

cases.rationale: claim_008's source_extract is invented text absent from the cited src_streetscape snapshot (best fuzzy 44 < 90), so extracts_appear_in_cited_source fails (route=block) for a high-weight claim. claim_text is unchanged so its money literals stay in the source and high_stakes_structured_match passes on claim_008 — isolating the failure to grounding. Asserted PER-CHECK on claim_008, not by the unit packet's overall verdict. Real precedent: the only hard block in the 488-briefing replay was this family.

claim_004 collapses the $42,000,000 net-proceeds cap and the $43,500,000 principal cap into a single invented $45,000,000 figure absent from the cited source. high_stakes_structured_match (money) extracts 45000000 from claim_text, finds it missing from the cited snapshot, and fails (route=block). The source_extract is left a verbatim substring so extracts_appear_in_cited_source still passes on claim_004 — isolating the failure to the money literal. Asserted per-check on claim_004.

claim_005 (budget_number, high-weight, the $18,400,000 trunk-line figure) is re-cited only to news source NEWS-1, outside its allowed [agenda_packet, government_website]. The $18,400,000 literal is planted in NEWS-1's snapshot and a matching extract is provided, so high_stakes_structured_match and extracts_appear_in_cited_source both pass on claim_005 — only source_hierarchy_policy fails (route=block). Uses claim_005 (not claim_008) so it does not collide with the extract-not-in-source defect on claim_008 in the same unit packet. Asserted per-check on claim_005.

The advocacy phrase 'Push for' is injected into item_001's authored display.summary, a policed prohibited_phrase_path. prohibited_phrases warns (route=annotate, never blocks). Asserted per-check on the prohibited_phrases finding.

FALSE-positive target. claim_009 is fully supported by src_streetscape but its extract is shortened to a true snippet ('$54,500.00 under estimate'). It is still a verbatim substring and the money literals stay in the cited source, so neither extracts_appear_in_cited_source nor high_stakes_structured_match may fail on claim_009. The deterministic assertion is auto-checked per-check; the Phase-1-over-flag / Phase-2-overturn LLM tendency (45/60 overturned in the 488-run) is documented, not auto-asserted.

FALSE-positive target. The advocacy phrase 'demand' appears only inside NEWS-2's source snapshot and claim_010's source_extract — never in an authored prose path. prohibited_phrases scans authored prose only, so 'demand' must NOT appear in any prohibited_phrases finding (the only thing it flags in the unit packet is the authored 'Push for' on item_001). Uses NEWS-2/claim_010 so it does not collide with the budget_cited_to_news defect on NEWS-1/claim_005. Asserted per-check.

expected_deterministic.note: faithful-paraphrase false positive; route=diagnostic never drives the verdict

cases.rationale: FALSE-positive target. The accurate-but-paraphrased-summary coherence false positive is inherited untouched from the clean baseline at item_005 and item_010. summary_source_coherence flags them but only as a diagnostic (route=diagnostic), which never drives the verdict — so this is a should-not-block, not a should-not-fire. Asserted per-check: every coherence warning routes diagnostic, and item_005/item_010 are named.

cases.proposed_check: Citation-discipline policy: when a claim's extract is not in its cited source but IS present in a different uncited source in the packet, flag the mis-citation (true-but-wrong-citation) rather than treating it as a generic low-weight extract miss. Conditional on the product adopting a citation-discipline policy.
cases.rationale: ROADMAP GAP, documentation-only (no runnable fixture; the standalone variant was removed in the packet-3.0 refactor). A true-but-wrong-citation defect — a low-weight news_context claim re-cited to a source that does not contain the (true) fact — is only annotated as a generic low-weight extract miss; no deterministic check enforces citation discipline. An LLM reading all snapshots would mark it 'Not in Source — Verified Elsewhere'. There is no check function to unit-test, so this is kept as a proposed_check only.

cases.proposed_check: Prioritization / salience check: detect a genuinely high-salience agenda item (e.g. a multi-million-dollar bond vote) demoted out of featured, or procedural trivia overemphasized as featured. No check scores attention allocation today.
cases.rationale: ROADMAP GAP, documentation-only (no runnable fixture). A genuinely high-salience item (a $42M+ sewer-bond vote) demoted out of featured leaves every claim/extract unchanged, so all grounding/accuracy checks pass and the verdict stays ok. No check evaluates whether the RIGHT items are featured. No check function exists to unit-test; kept as a proposed_check only.

cases.proposed_check: Actionability / preparation-value check: detect featured prose that only restates the agenda line without giving the official anything to prepare, decide, or ask. No check scores preparation usefulness today.
cases.rationale: ROADMAP GAP, documentation-only (no runnable fixture). Featured prose that merely restates the agenda with no preparation value stays grounded (the facts are in the source), so coherence/grounding pass and the verdict stays ok. No check scores actionability. No check function exists to unit-test; kept as a proposed_check only.

cases.proposed_check: Toxicity / discrimination gate: detect demeaning, abusive, or discriminatory language in EO-facing prose. prohibited_phrases only matches advocacy verbs; there is no toxicity classifier today.
cases.rationale: ROADMAP GAP, documentation-only (no runnable fixture). Demeaning language in an authored summary is not matched by prohibited_phrases (advocacy verbs only) and no toxicity check exists, so nothing fires and the verdict stays ok. No check function exists to unit-test; kept as a proposed_check only. (Any such defect would be fully synthetic; targets no real person or group.)

cases.proposed_check: Inappropriate-PII gate: detect individual-level voter data (named voter with address/phone/score) in EO-facing prose, distinct from the allowed aggregate haystaq sentiment. No PII check exists today.
cases.rationale: ROADMAP GAP, documentation-only (no runnable fixture). An individual-level voter datum in EO-facing prose — exactly what the aggregate haystaq sources avoid — is caught by no check today, so nothing fires and the verdict stays ok. No check function exists to unit-test; kept as a proposed_check only. (Any such named voter would be fictional; contrast the aggregate HAYSTAQ-1/2 sources, which are appropriate.)

cases.proposed_check: Professional-register check: detect chatbot/campaign-memo tone ('Great question!', 'gonna', 'Let me know if...') in EO-facing prose. Only mechanical polish_grammar (typos, doubled words) exists, not register.
cases.rationale: ROADMAP GAP, documentation-only (no runnable fixture). Chatbot/campaign-memo register keeps money literals correct, so structured/grounding checks pass; polish_grammar is mechanical only and finds no typo, so nothing fires and the verdict stays ok. No check function exists to unit-test; kept as a proposed_check only.

rubric_coverage._about: Maps each of the 5 scored rubric dimensions and 4 gating checks to whether a deterministic check covers it today. status 'covered' means at least one deterministic check fires on a planted defect of this dimension; 'gap' means no check exists and the defect lands in fails_not_yet_caught with a proposed_check. cases lists the manifest case_ids exercising the dimension; check_ids lists the deterministic checks that cover it (empty for gaps).

Accuracy.note: Deterministic coverage is the high-stakes literal match (money/date/vote/legal/name), exercised by accuracy_money_mismatch_blocks_on_structured_match (caught) and falsepos_truncated_extract_does_not_block (false positive). Subtler accuracy (negation inversion, stale-superseded figures, certainty inflation) is LLM-dependent or a gap not currently exercised by a fixture in this packet.

Grounding & Traceability.note: Strong deterministic coverage for extract-in-source and source-type policy. The true-but-wrong-citation sub-case is only partially covered (annotates as a low-weight extract miss; no citation-discipline policy) — a gap.

Prioritization.note: No check scores attention allocation (right items featured, trivia not overemphasized).

Coverage.note: claim_coverage and completeness_floor cover under-emission and skeleton output (diagnostic/annotate) in the spine, but no fixture in this packet exercises them: the coverage cases lived on the orphaned packet-1.0 layer and were dropped in 3.1. Omitted-topic coverage (a sub-topic the source raised but no claim addresses) remains a gap.

Actionability.note: No check scores preparation value of featured prose.

Gating: no political advocacy.note: prohibited_phrases annotates advocacy verbs on authored prose paths and correctly does NOT fire on the same phrase inside a quoted source extract.

Gating: no toxic/discriminatory.note: No toxicity/discrimination classifier; prohibited_phrases matches advocacy verbs only.

Gating: no inappropriate PII.note: No check distinguishes individual-level voter data (disallowed) from aggregate haystaq sentiment (allowed).

Gating: professional register.note: Only mechanical polish_grammar exists; nothing scores chatbot/campaign-memo register.
